description: This file defines the React component 'QuizAssignPage' which manages the UI for assigning quizzes to courses or sessions within a learning management system. It handles loading quiz data, creating and removing assignments, and rendering the assignment form and existing assignments.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads quiz details and, if authorized, fetches related courses, sessions, and current assignments.

methods.name: refreshAssignments
methods.description: Refreshes the list of quiz assignments from the data source.

methods.name: onAssign
methods.description: Handles the form submission to create a new quiz assignment.

methods.name: onRemoveAssignment
methods.description: Handles the removal of an existing quiz assignment.
